description.value:
Primary (24 hours): without a cyberspine, DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs or the effects of Spinal Injury for the duration; Critical Injuries deal you no Bonus Damage and their STAT and Check penalties are halved (other effects stay); +1 to Surgery for Treatments on you; you're exhausted and foggy. Secondary (DV17): you remember nothing of the high; if you're hooked on Berserker or Black Lace, 1d6 Humanity Loss; addicted, and without a dose, INT and COOL −2.

Cost: 100eb
